jobs.prompt: Bump the version from 1.167.10 to 1.167.11. In package.json and package-lock.json (both places in the lock: the top version and packages[""].version) change 1.167.10 to 1.167.11. In README.md change every 1.167.10 pin (kickoff text, tag name) to 1.167.11. In these tests replace the 1.167.10 pin with 1.167.11 where it is the current-version pin (assertions, test titles, the pin map in the AH release test): tests/t101-release.test.mjs, tests/field-lesson-t80-cli.test.mjs, tests/field-lessons-batch-x.test.mjs, tests/field-lessons-batch-ab-release.test.mjs, tests/field-lessons-batch-ag-release.test.mjs, tests/field-lessons-batch-ah-release.test.mjs. In CHANGELOG.md add a NEW top entry ## 1.167.11 above the 1.167.10 entry (keep it unchanged) with the lead-in line: The swarm limits itself by real memory and never deletes a checkout that holds its state. And these bullets, each starting with a bold lead word: Memory: the machine limit reads available memory and swap (vm_stat and sysctl on macOS, meminfo on Linux), holds new job starts at hard pressure, shrinks wide waves at soft pressure, and lowers the node test concurrency of the merge-queue gate (never raises a configured value). Board: swarm watch --all --keep-up never stops when idle and keeps one token and port across restarts (identity file in the config folder, mode 0600). Ledger: every ledger write is backed up outside the checkout (newest 50 plus a daily copy for 90 days); swarm backup ledger now, list and restore bring it back. Guard: gc, scratch cleanup and swarm merge refuse to delete or detach a checkout that holds swarm state, and log every deletion attempt to deletions.log. Do not touch any other file. Note the version has two digits in the last part: pins like 1.167.11 must not be confused with 1.167.1 in assertions (use exact matches).
